seoTitle: Image Compressor to a Target File Size
metaDescription: Compress JPG, PNG or WebP input into JPG or WebP with a size target as low as 50 KB.
intro: Compress JPG, PNG or WebP input into JPG or WebP with a size target as low as 50 KB.
aboutTitle: How does the compressor reach a size target?
about: The browser re-encodes the image and can reduce its dimensions if needed. Compare the output size and preview before replacing a production image.
example: Upload your source image, select WebP and choose a 100 KB target. Inspect the text and edges in the preview before downloading.

faqs.question: Will the compressed image keep its original dimensions?
faqs.answer: It keeps the dimensions when the target can be met at that size. A tighter target may require a smaller image.
